master:
Use case: precise-object-edit / terrain outpainting.
Asset type: one continuous ground-only master texture for two adjoining sections of the existing Safety Last open world.
Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET: a 3072 × 1660 template. Its LEFT 704 pixels show the existing camp; its BOTTOM 256 pixels show the existing woodland junction. White space and the black old boundary fade are the ONLY areas to replace. Keep the canvas framing, camera and pixel scale. Preserve the leftmost 256 pixels and bottommost 128 pixels faithfully in place. Do not move, enlarge or shrink the existing ground.
Input 2 is a supporting STYLE reference: the current camp at close scale. Input 3 is a GEOGRAPHIC GUIDE only: village north/northeast of camp and industrial works further east. Do not copy its zoomed-out miniature scenery or bake its buildings into this texture.

Fill ALL white and old black edge fade with seamlessly adjoining terrain. Continue the exact warm ochre soil, tiny angular grit, embedded worn diagonal brick fragments, flat dry orange/brown fallen leaves, and irregular muted olive moss. Crisp softly painted overhead game art, neutral even light, identical material scale. Avoid enlarging leaves into flowers or increasing stone size. No dramatic color bands, no blur, no global grading. Leave organically shaped open ground for later separately placed props.

The narrow tan dirt footpath already enters from the BOTTOM strip at roughly 81% of canvas width. Continue that same path smoothly NORTH through the new ground, gently bending left to leave the TOP edge at 65% of canvas width. It should have the same width, gritty surface and irregular softly worn edges as its existing entrance. Add one small dirt branch from the path toward the RIGHT edge at about 43% of image height for the future eastern works. Near the top, a few flat embedded pale worn paving fragments can hint at the later village approach, but this remains mostly woodland ground. The left half should be quiet, natural camp-edge earth and low flat moss without a new large road.

Output ONE opaque landscape master, matching target 3072:1660 aspect ratio, at the highest available resolution, ideally 3072 × 1660. Full ground texture to all four edges.
No labels, text, grids, panels, borders, vignette, white spaces, trees, bushes, tall grass, upright plants, resource boulders, logs, stumps, water, buildings, walls, rails, characters, fire, or cast shadows from absent objects. Only ground and embedded paths. Preserve both existing contact edges; outpaint the missing northward terrain.
